home.lead: Solar size, PM Surya Ghar subsidy, real cost and payback, worked out from your own bill and the sunlight where you live.
home.privacy: The photo is deleted right after reading. No login, no Aadhaar.
home.manual: No bill at hand? Enter your units yourself
home.exampleText: until a 2.5 kW system has paid for itself. After that, about ₹16,400 a year stays in your pocket.
home.how1: Two AI models on Amazon Bedrock read your bill, in any Indian language.
home.how2: You confirm the few numbers they don't agree on.
home.how3: System size, subsidy, payback, loan EMI and the 7 steps to apply.
home.why: The government pays up to ₹78,000 towards rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar, but most families don't know if it makes sense for them. Your bill already has the answer.
home.faq1q: I live in a flat. Can I still get the subsidy?
home.faq1a: Yes, through your housing society (RWA). It gets ₹18,000 per kW for a shared system on the common roof.
home.faq2q: My bill is zero because of free units.
home.faq2a: Then solar may not save you money right now. The app will tell you that honestly.
home.faq3a: No. The official portal needs your Aadhaar and an OTP, so only you should apply. We give you a filled-in sheet to copy from.

plan.listenText: {{verdict}}. A {{kw}} kilowatt system costs {{cost}}. After the subsidy of {{subsidy}}, you pay {{pay}}. You save about {{saving}} a month, and it pays for itself in {{payback}} years.

reasons.PAYBACK_SHORT: It pays for itself in under 7 years, well within the 25-year life of the panels.
reasons.PAYBACK_MEDIUM: It takes 7 to 10 years to pay back. A low-interest loan makes it easier.
reasons.PAYBACK_LONG: It takes a long time to pay back at your current usage.
reasons.EMI_COVERED_BY_SAVING: The loan EMI is covered by what you save each month.
reasons.FREE_UNITS_BAND: Your state's free units already cover most of your bill, so solar would save very little.
reasons.LOW_USAGE: Your usage is low, so the saving is small.
reasons.NO_SAVINGS: Your bill is already very low, so there's little to save.
reasons.NON_RESIDENTIAL: This is not a home connection. PM Surya Ghar is for homes only. For farms, look at PM-KUSUM.
reasons.ALREADY_SOLAR: You already have solar. Check it's working, or add more (subsidy only up to 3 kW in total).
reasons.LOAD_CAP: Your sanctioned load limits the system size.
reasons.ROOF_CAP: Your free roof area limits the system size.
reasons.MAX_10KW_CAP: Home systems are kept to 10 kW, the most the quick approval covers.
reasons.PREVIOUS_SUBSIDY: This house had a solar subsidy before, so only a top-up up to 3 kW in total can get subsidy.
reasons.TARIFF_ESTIMATE: Based on reported tariff slabs, so the real saving may differ a little.
reasons.TARIFF_ROUGH: Based on the rate from your own bill, so treat it as a rough figure.

fix.CHECK_NAME_ON_BILL_VS_BANK: Check that the name on the bill matches your bank account exactly. If not, get the name changed at your DISCOM first, or the subsidy can't be paid.
fix.CHANGE_NAME_ON_BILL_OR_USE_MATCHING_ACCO: Get the bill moved to your name at the DISCOM office, or use a bank account in the bill holder's name.
fix.APPLY_FOR_LOAD_INCREASE: Ask your DISCOM for a load increase (usually an online request) to fit the bigger system.
fix.ENTER_SANCTIONED_LOAD_FROM_BILL: Find the sanctioned load on your bill and enter it.
fix.ASK_OWNER_TO_APPLY_OR_USE_RWA_ROUTE: The roof owner has to apply. In a flat, your housing society can apply for the common roof.
fix.CONFIRM_ROOF_OWNERSHIP: Confirm you own the roof, or ask the owner to apply.
fix.CONFIRM_NO_EARLIER_SUBSIDY: Confirm this house never got a solar subsidy before.
fix.CONFIRM_DOMESTIC_CATEGORY: Check the bill's tariff category is domestic or residential.
fix.SCHEME_IS_RESIDENTIAL_ONLY_SEE_PM_KUSUM_: PM Surya Ghar is for homes only. For farms, look at PM-KUSUM.
fix.ENTER_CONSUMER_NUMBER_FROM_BILL: Copy the consumer number from your bill. You'll need it to register.
fix.CHECK_EXISTING_SYSTEM_OR_ADD_CAPACITY_UP: You already have solar. You can add more, with subsidy only up to 3 kW in total.
fix.CHECK_UNITS_AGAINST_METER: This bill used an estimated reading. Check the units against your meter, or use a bill with an actual reading.
fix.TOPUP_ONLY_UP_TO_3KW_TOTAL: You can only get subsidy for the part that takes your total up to 3 kW.

steps.d: 10 minutes on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your consumer number and mobile.
Approved automatically for systems up to 10 kW.
Choose a registered vendor on the portal. Check the panels are DCR (made in India).
Usually 1 to 2 days on the roof.
A new two-way meter. Takes 1 to 4 weeks.
They check the system and you upload photos on the portal.
Add your bank details. Money arrives in about 15 to 30 days.

vendor: Are the panels DCR (made in India from Indian cells)? Ask for the certificate number. Non-DCR panels lose the whole subsidy.
Is 5 years of maintenance included in the price?
Who handles the net meter application?
Is the price per kW for the panels (DC kW)?
What is the payment schedule? Never pay in full before installation.
redFlags: Don't install before the feasibility approval comes through.
Don't pay anyone who says they are "from the government". Registering on the portal is free.
Never share your OTP with a vendor.

warn.UNITS_OUT_OF_RANGE: The units look wrong. Please check them.
warn.LOAD_OUT_OF_RANGE: The sanctioned load looks wrong. Please check it.
warn.AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The amount looks wrong. Please check it.
warn.HISTORY_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Some past months look wrong. Please check them.
warn.HISTORY_MONTH_IN_FUTURE: A past month has a date in the future. Please check it.
warn.HISTORY_SINGLE_MONTH: Only one past month was found.
warn.NO_HISTORY: No past months on the bill. We'll use this month's units for the whole year, adjusted for the seasons.
warn.BILLING_CYCLE_VS_DAYS: The number of billing days doesn't match the billing cycle.
warn.BILLING_DATES_ORDER: The billing dates look the wrong way round.
warn.ESTIMATED_READING: This bill used an estimated meter reading, so the units may be off.
warn.ALREADY_HAS_SOLAR: This bill shows a solar net meter. You may already have solar.
warn.NON_RESIDENTIAL: This looks like a shop, farm or business connection. PM Surya Ghar is for homes only.
warn.NO_UNITS: We couldn't find the units. Please type them in.
warn.STATE_MISMATCH_PINCODE_VS_BILL: The PIN code is in a different state from the bill. We used the bill's state.
warn.UP_RURAL_TARIFF_NOT_MODELLED: Rural tariffs in Uttar Pradesh aren't covered yet, so we used the urban one.
warn.BILLING_CYCLE_DIFFERS_FROM_DISCOM: Your billing cycle is different from what this DISCOM usually uses.
warn.NON_RESIDENTIAL_TARIFF_FROM_BILL: The bill's tariff isn't a home tariff.
warn.DISCOM_NOT_MODELLED: We don't have this power company's tariff yet, so the figures are rough.
warn.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_RATE: We couldn't work out your rate per unit, so we used a typical one.
